title: Word Ladder
description: Unscramble the scrambled words as fast as you can to score points.
how_to_play:
1. Press Enter to start.
2. Type the correct word formed from scrambled letters and press Enter.
3. Correct answers increase score. A mistake ends the run.

Tips:
- Look for common prefixes/suffixes.
- Try to spot vowels first.
